mintAuthority.summary: RUSD is issued independently by RIB / Royal Coins (Hong Kong) through non-upgradeable native token contracts on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Tron. Chain-local DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE accounts can re-authorize MASTERMINTER_ROLE and therefore restore direct minting, while no current MASTERMINTER_ROLE holder was identified at the observed blocks. These controls are native Mint Authority; the three reviewed routes carry no bridge machinery.

controls.label: RUSD Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770558, owner() returned 0xc50ebe57ae937a8ac0bcaab8945777c3be54a511, while hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned true and hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned false. The verified source gates grantRole and revokeRole through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and gates mintByMaster through MASTERMINTER_ROLE. Ethereum RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history shows the prior owner role assignments were revoked; no current MASTERMINTER_ROLE holder was identified in the indexed history. The deployment has no proxy, implementation, or admin slots.

controls.label: RUSD BSC DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116350808, owner() returned 0xc50ebe57ae937a8ac0bcaab8945777c3be54a511, while hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned true and hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned false. The verified token source uses DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to manage MASTERMINTER_ROLE and MASTERMINTER_ROLE to authorize mintByMaster. The deployment has no proxy, implementation, or admin slots; the former owner account is not a current mint-role holder at the observed block.

controls.label: RUSD Tron DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account
controls.evidence: At Tron block 85415800, owner() returned the former owner 0x9a0c5f3a73fafb8bd7e7c4c8295cdd8daa87f692, while hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xed82999e) returned true and hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0xed82999e) returned false. Tronscan transaction history shows 0x9a0c5f3a was granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MASTERMINTER_ROLE earlier, used mintByMaster, and later renounced both roles; the current admin can re-authorize MASTERMINTER_ROLE. The verified deployment is not a proxy.

review.evidence: Current role reads resolve the native control graph across Ethereum, BSC, and Tron: each deployment is immutable; a chain-local DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA can grant or revoke MASTERMINTER_ROLE and can therefore re-enable direct minting, while the formerly recorded owner accounts no longer hold MASTERMINTER_ROLE at the observed blocks. No current MASTERMINTER_ROLE holder was identified, so the record does not assign direct mint authority to an unverified account. These issuer-admin controls remain in Mint Authority and are not bridge controls; the three route records are independently reviewed as native issuance. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: chain-local issuer admins can re-enable unrestricted minting, no recurring whole-supply attestation is evidenced, and no prudential authorization is recorded.
